audit.why: 53.57% over 715 games. Pantheon owns the first five levels against a dashless scaler and hands over the late game. The written arc matches the chart.
The spike placement is right — your levels 1-3, her level 6 sleep, her two-item Liandry's timing. Only the mechanics attached to them needed fixing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate strings tell you to play around Lillia's 'W heal-bounce' and its slow — spikes[1], early, mid, wants.foe[0] and whys[2].
audit.why: Watch Out! Eep! does none of those things. Riot's text is 'Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center' — no heal, no bounce, no slow, and no movement at all. It is a stationary AoE with a strong middle, so the counterplay is standing off-centre, not blocking a disengage. The slow is Swirlseed (E) on a flat 12s, and the movement speed is the passive half of Blooming Blows (Q), which stacks as she hits things. The page has the player holding Aegis Assault for an ability that cannot be aimed at him and ignoring the two that can.
audit.corrected: Watch Out! Eep! restated as a centred AoE, the slow moved to Swirlseed, and the kiting speed moved to Blooming Blows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing about the true damage on Blooming Blows, and nothing about how Lilting Lullaby actually triggers.
audit.why: Blooming Blows deals extra true damage on the fourth hit, so armour does not answer her ramp — the page tells you her damage scales without saying part of it ignores your build. And Lilting Lullaby only makes enemies drowsy if they already carry Dream Dust from her abilities, so the sleep is not a free reset button: if she has not touched you, she cannot put you down. That is a real thing to play around and it was absent.
audit.corrected: True damage written into late, the Dream Dust precondition into mid.

audit.why: Swirlseed is a flat 12s at every rank and is her only slow and her only long-range disengage tool — that number is the whole engage window. Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1. Blooming Blows falls from 6s to 4s.
audit.corrected: Swirlseed's 12s and Lilting Lullaby's 150s written into mid and the level-6 spike.

edits.before: Full kit online: W-stun, E channel to eat her W bounce slow, empowered-Q burst — this is your premier kill window before she gets W/E spacing.
edits.after: Full kit online: Shield Vault, Aegis Assault faced at Swirlseed, empowered Comet Spear — your premier kill window while Swirlseed is her only answer.

edits.before: Grand Starfall is for roaming, not killing her — her R sleep is the bigger 1v1 threat, so use R to make plays bot/mid instead of forcing a dash-vs-kite duel.
edits.after: Grand Starfall is for roaming — Lilting Lullaby is 150s and only puts you to sleep if she has already landed Dream Dust on you, so deny that and make plays elsewhere.

edits.before: Kite your W-gap with her W heal-bounce and E movement, never letting you stick
edits.after: Kite Shield Vault with Blooming Blows speed and Swirlseed slow, never let you stick

edits.before: Full kit at 3: W-stun pins her, E channels through her W slow, empowered-Q bursts — your premier kill window before her spacing matures.
edits.after: Full kit at 3: Shield Vault pins her, Aegis Assault eats Swirlseed, empowered Comet Spear bursts — your premier kill window before she spaces.

edits.before: You still own 4-5 with empowered-Q poke and E blocks; she can only W-bounce away, and you punish every step she takes to farm.
edits.after: You still own 4-5 with empowered Comet Spear; Swirlseed is 12s flat and it is all she has, so you punish every step she takes to farm.

edits.before: Lillia has no dash and her passive DOT can't beat your level-1 W-stun damage, so this is your lane. Lead with the point-and-click Shield Vault (W) to pin her — she can't blink out of it — then tapped-Q for the reset and burst. Don't waste your held long-range Q chasing her across the wave; save it for when she's pinned by the stun. Your E channel eats her W heal-bounce slow if she tries to disengage, so commit hard at 2 and 3.
edits.after: Lillia has no dash and Dream-Laden Bough's burn can't beat your level-1 damage, so this is your lane. Lead with point-and-click Shield Vault (W) to pin her — she cannot blink out — then tap Comet Spear for the burst. Don't waste the held long-range spear chasing her across the wave; save it for when the stun has her. Watch Out! Eep! is a stationary AoE that hits hardest dead centre, so stand off-centre rather than trying to block it, and commit at 2 and 3.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke and W all-ins — her only answer is to W-bounce away and rebuild spacing with movespeed, so keep her shoved and deny the escape. At 6 don't get greedy 1v1: Grand Starfall (R) is a roam tool here, not a kill button, and her R sleep is the trap that flips a bad all-in. Use your tempo to crash and roam rather than dive a champion built to kite you.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you control the lane with empowered Comet Spear and Shield Vault all-ins. Her only answer is Swirlseed's slow on a flat 12s, and the movement speed she rebuilds spacing with is the passive half of Blooming Blows — so engage in the twelve seconds after Swirlseed and she has nothing. At 6, Lilting Lullaby needs Dream Dust already on you to make you drowsy, so refuse her poke and the 150s ult has no target. Roam with Grand Starfall.

edits.before: This is where she takes over. Once Lillia hits two items her Liandry's/Riftmaker DOT ramps, her W/E kite outpaces your dash, and R sleep lets her reset any fight you start. Your burst plateaus while her damage scales, so don't chase her in the late game — your only path is the lead you already built. Win before two items or hand her the splitpush and teamfight.
edits.after: This is where she takes over. Two-item Liandry's or Riftmaker ramps her burn, Blooming Blows stacks speed she kites Shield Vault with, and its fourth hit is true damage, so armour will not save the trade. Lilting Lullaby resets any fight she is losing. Your burst plateaus while hers scales — don't chase her late, play the lead you already built. Win before two items or hand her the map.

notes: REAL ERROR IN FIVE STRINGS: the page repeatedly told the player to hold Aegis Assault for Lillia's 'W heal-bounce' and its slow. Watch Out! Eep! has no heal, no bounce, no slow and no movement — Riot's text is 'Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center'. The player was being told to spend a 22-second cooldown blocking a disengage that does not exist, while her actual slow (Swirlseed, flat 12s) and her actual kiting speed (the passive half of Blooming Blows) went unmentioned. Also added the Lilting Lullaby precondition: it only makes enemies drowsy if they already carry Dream Dust from her abilities, so refusing her poke removes the ult from the lane entirely — a genuine counterplay the page framed as an unavoidable reset button. And Blooming Blows' fourth hit is true damage, which the late-game text needed since it was recommending you simply outlast her.
